name: asset-scene
description: Asset-type scene: three use-case cards arranged around the assistant artwork, with a closing line and two buttons. Live: .apx-bft on /asset-intelligence-platform/.

anchor.description: id on the section (letters, digits, hyphens), e.g. reseller-program on Partners.

title_accent.description: Part of the heading painted with the brand gradient.

mobile_image.description: No longer drawn (QA 2026-10-29): narrow screens show the main artwork cropped, so its connector lines stay. Kept so existing blocks still validate.

items.description: Up to three cards. Each: kicker, title, body, link_label, url; slot (it, field, safety) decides where it sits.

splash.description: A soft indigo-and-green gradient splash centred behind the heading and the scene (Partners' Become a Partner, Joseph 2026-10-31).

attached.description: Desktop: each card pinned to its icon disc (the top card's foot, the side cards' inner edges on the disc), the cards drawn in closer and the artwork (orb and panda) at 78%, for a section with little copy (Partners' Become a Partner, Joseph 2026-10-31). Tablets and phones keep the stacked layout.
